description.value:
Frequency once per encounter

Trigger Your last prepared Graft is consumed.

Cost 2 Vitae

Immediately Cut one new Graft of any Mark you can produce, without spending an action and without risking a Bloom. It must be thrown before the end of your next turn or it is wasted.

cinderfall.incomplete: This card's entire payload is a Vitae-spend/gain beyond the bare pool, a Bloom Table roll/choice, Resonance, Load, Strain, or "Mk" grade -- none of which has any rule-element representation anywhere in this corpus. fleshmancer.vitae-pool.json's own SpecialResource (slug: vitae, max: 10, renew: false) only declares the bare pool; its schema (value, max, itemUUID, level, renew) has no field for a per-source gain/spend/reroll/choose trigger, so every Vitae-cost/-gain clause on every other card is inert as far as system.rules is concerned, and Bloom/Resonance/Load/Strain have no representation at all. Specifically, instant on-demand Graft-crafting with a Bloom-risk waiver depends on "Cut," itself unmodeled.
